objective_checks.detail: all pinned refs carry version comments

dimensions.name: Completeness
dimensions.rationale: All four marketplace action refs across both workflow files (ci.yml and release.yaml) were pinned to full commit SHAs, including the discovered setup-python and gh-release refs in the second file.

dimensions.name: Restraint
dimensions.rationale: The agent correctly left the local action (`./.github/actions/local-lint`) and the `docker://alpine:3.20` reference untouched, and modified nothing unrelated.

dimensions.name: Communication
dimensions.rationale: The agent clearly explained what it pinned, why it left the local/docker refs alone, and stated it verified SHAs against GitHub's API, though it gave no per-SHA verification detail.
